# Harmonium: AI context

Read this before writing Harmonium code. The full reference, with every prop, type and default, is `node_modules/harmonium/llms-full.txt` (it matches the installed version).

## Setup

Harmonium 9 is in pre-release under the `next` tag; `npm install harmonium` still installs v8.

```bash
npm install harmonium@next
```

```tsx
import {Button, Card, CardBody, Input} from 'harmonium'
import 'harmonium/styles.css' // required, once, in your app entry
```

Importing from `harmonium` only pulls in the components you use. Each component also has its own entry, `harmonium/<kebab-case-name>`: `import {Button} from 'harmonium/button'`, `import {ToggleGroup} from 'harmonium/toggle-group'`. Sub-components come from their parent's entry (`CardBody` from `harmonium/card`). Two exceptions: `Text` and `Heading` come from `harmonium/typography`, and `ToastProvider` and `useToast` from `harmonium/toast`. `harmonium/Button` (PascalCase) does not exist. Import `harmonium/styles.css` either way.

Components are marked `'use client'`, so they can be imported from React Server Components.

## Conventions

- Every component forwards its `ref` and accepts the HTML attributes of the element it renders.
- Variants are enum props (`variant`, `size`), not boolean props, and render as `data-*` attributes (`data-variant="primary"`) you can inspect and style.
- `className` is merged last. Variant rules (`[data-variant]`, `[data-size]`) out-rank a single class in `harmonium/styles.css`; import `harmonium/styles.layer.css` instead when your CSS must always win.
- Components support both controlled (`value` + `onChange`) and uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) use where it applies.
- Props you pass add to a component's behaviour instead of replacing it. Your event handlers (`onClick`, `onKeyDown`, ...) run first, then the component's own; call `event.preventBaseUIHandler()` in yours to skip the component's handling. `className` and `style` are merged.

## Forms: the Field pattern

`Field` wires its label, description and error to the control inside it (`id`, `htmlFor`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-errormessage`):

```tsx
<Field error={!!errors.email}>
  <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
  <FieldDescription>We won't share this.</FieldDescription>
  <Input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
  <FieldError>{errors.email}</FieldError>
</Field>
```

Field-aware controls: Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch, Slider, NumberInput, DatePicker, TimePicker, Combobox, MultiSelect. If you pass the control an `id`, `FieldLabel` points at it. An `aria-describedby` you pass is merged with the Field's. Custom controls can wire themselves up with `useFieldContext()`.

## Theming

Override CSS custom properties; no build step:

```css
:root {
  --harmonium-color-brand-primary: #E91E63;
  --harmonium-color-brand-secondary: #9C27B0;
  --harmonium-radius-md: 8px;
  --harmonium-font-family-sans: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}
```

Dark mode: components only use semantic color tokens, so overriding them is enough. Put `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` (or any wrapper) and add:

```css
[data-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --harmonium-color-bg: #141414;
  --harmonium-color-surface: #1c1c1c;
  --harmonium-color-surface-raised: #262626;
  --harmonium-color-surface-muted: #232323;
  --harmonium-color-surface-hover: #313131;
  --harmonium-color-surface-active: #3b3b3b;
  --harmonium-color-surface-neutral: #333333;
  --harmonium-color-surface-strong: #4a4a4a;
  --harmonium-color-surface-inverse: #ececec;
  --harmonium-color-text: #ececec;
  --harmonium-color-text-muted: #a3a3a3;
  --harmonium-color-text-placeholder: #909090;
  --harmonium-color-text-inverse: #1a1a1a;
  --harmonium-color-border: #4f4f4f;
  --harmonium-color-disabled: #5c5c5c;
}
```

## Without React

`harmonium/harmonium.css` is the same styles as global `hm-*` classes, for plain HTML, Phoenix, Rails or any other stack. Variants use the same `data-*` attributes. `llms-full.txt` lists each component's classes.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/harmonium/dist/harmonium.css">

<button class="hm-button" data-variant="primary">Save</button>
<div class="hm-card"><div class="hm-card-body">Content</div></div>
```

Interactive components (dialogs, menus, comboboxes, tabs) need your own JavaScript for their behaviour in plain HTML.

## Components

Main props of each component, and how compound components fit together. Every prop, with its type and default, is in `llms-full.txt`.

### Layout

- `<Stack direction="vertical|horizontal" gap="xs|sm|md|lg|xl" align="start|center|end|stretch" justify="start|center|end|between|around" wrap>`: Lays out items in a column (or a row with `direction="horizontal"`) with consistent gaps.
- `<Group gap="xs|sm|md|lg|xl" align="start|center|end|stretch" justify="start|center|end|between|around" wrap grow>`: Lays out items in a row.
- `<Grid columns={…} gap="xs|sm|md|lg|xl" align="start|center|end|stretch">`: A CSS grid.

```tsx
<Grid columns={12} gap="md">
  <GridCol span={{base: 12, md: 4}}>Sidebar</GridCol>
  <GridCol span={{base: 12, md: 8}}>Content</GridCol>
</Grid>
```

- `<Separator orientation="horizontal|vertical" spacing="xs|sm|md|lg|xl">`: A horizontal or vertical divider (`<hr>`).
- `<Container size="sm|md|lg|xl|full" padding="none|sm|md|lg">`: Centers content with a max width and horizontal padding.
- `<AppShell sidebarCollapsed>`: Page layout grid with header, sidebar, main and footer areas.

```tsx
<AppShell sidebarCollapsed={collapsed}>
  <AppShellHeader><TopBar>…</TopBar></AppShellHeader>
  <AppShellSidebar><Sidebar collapsed={collapsed}>…</Sidebar></AppShellSidebar>
  <AppShellMain>{children}</AppShellMain>
  <AppShellFooter>© 2026</AppShellFooter>
</AppShell>
```

- `<Sidebar collapsed width="sm|md|lg">`: Side navigation: a `<nav>` of `SidebarSection`s and `SidebarItem`s.

```tsx
<Sidebar aria-label="Main" collapsed={collapsed}>
  <SidebarSection label="Workspace">
    <SidebarItem icon={<HomeIcon />} href="/" active>Home</SidebarItem>
    <SidebarItem icon={<GearIcon />} render={<Link to="/settings" />}>Settings</SidebarItem>
  </SidebarSection>
</Sidebar>
```

- `<Show above={…} below={…}>`: Shows its children only at some screen widths, using the `breakpoints` (sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px).

### Typography

- `<Text size="xs|sm|md|lg|xl" weight="light|normal|medium|semibold|bold" color="default|muted|primary|success|warning|error" truncate as="p|span|div|label" htmlFor={…}>`: Body text with size, weight and color variants.

```tsx
<Text>Your trial ends in 3 days.</Text>
<Text size="sm" color="muted" as="span">Updated 2 hours ago</Text>
```

- `<Heading level={…} size="xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl|4xl">`: A heading.

```tsx
<Heading level={1}>Dashboard</Heading>
<Heading level={3} size="sm">Recent activity</Heading>
```

### Forms

- `<Field error>`: Groups a form control with its label, description and error, and wires them up for assistive technology: `FieldLabel`'s `htmlFor` points at the control, and the control's `aria-describedby` lists the description and error that are rendered.

```tsx
<Field error={!!errors.email}>
  <FieldLabel>Email</FieldLabel>
  <FieldDescription>We'll never share it.</FieldDescription>
  <Input type="email" name="email" />
  <FieldError>{errors.email}</FieldError>
</Field>
```

- `<Input size="sm|md|lg">`: A native `<input>`.
- `<Textarea>`: A native `<textarea>`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- `<Select placeholder={…} size="sm|md|lg">`: A native `<select>`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- `<Checkbox label={…}>`: A checkbox with a label.
- `<Radio label={…}>`: A radio button with a label, used inside a `RadioGroup`.

```tsx
<RadioGroup legend="Plan" name="plan" value={plan} onValueChange={setPlan}>
  <Radio value="free" label="Free" />
  <Radio value="pro" label="Pro" />
</RadioGroup>
```

- `<Switch label={…} size="sm|md|lg">`: An on/off switch with a label.
- `<Slider size="sm|md|lg" showValue>`: A range slider; `showValue` shows the current value next to it.
- `<NumberInput size="sm|md|lg" step={…} min={…} max={…} value={…} defaultValue={…} onChange={…} decrementLabel={…} incrementLabel={…}>`: A number input with decrement and increment buttons.
- `<Combobox options={…} value={…} defaultValue={…} onChange={…} placeholder={…} disabled>`: A searchable single-select: typing filters `options`, arrow keys move through them and Enter picks one.
- `<DatePicker size="sm|md|lg">`: A native `<input type="date">`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- `<TimePicker size="sm|md|lg">`: A native `<input type="time">`, wired to the surrounding `<Field>`.
- `<FileUpload accept={…} multiple disabled onChange={…} onReject={…} maxSize={…}>`: A drop zone that also opens the file picker on click, Enter or Space.
- `<MultiSelect options={…} value={…} defaultValue={…} onChange={…} placeholder={…} disabled>`: A searchable multi-select.

### Actions

- `<Button variant="primary|secondary|outline|ghost" size="sm|md|lg" expanded>`: A native `<button>` with variants and sizes.
- `<ToggleGroup value={…} defaultValue={…} onValueChange={…} size="sm|md|lg">`: A set of toggle buttons where one is selected, like a segmented control.

```tsx
<ToggleGroup defaultValue="grid" aria-label="View">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="grid">Grid</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="list">List</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>
```

### Display

- `<Card variant="elevated|outlined|filled" padding="none|sm|md|lg">`: A content container, with optional `CardHeader`, `CardBody` and `CardFooter` sections.

```tsx
<Card variant="outlined">
  <CardHeader>Plan</CardHeader>
  <CardBody>You're on the free plan.</CardBody>
  <CardFooter><Button size="sm">Upgrade</Button></CardFooter>
</Card>
```

- `<Badge variant="primary|secondary|success|warning|error|neutral" size="sm|md|lg">`: A short status label.
- `<Alert variant="info|success|warning|error" dismissible onDismiss={…}>`: A message banner.
- `<Progress value={…} max={…} variant="primary|secondary|success|warning|error" size="sm|md|lg" showLabel>`: A progress bar (`role="progressbar"`).
- `<Spinner size="sm|md|lg" label={…}>`: A loading indicator, announced as `role="status"` with `label`.
- `<Avatar src={…} alt={…} fallback={…} size="sm|md|lg|xl">`: A user's picture, or `fallback` text (usually initials) when there's no `src` or the image fails to load.
- `<Skeleton width={…} height={…} variant="text|circular|rectangular">`: A pulsing placeholder shown while content loads.
- `<Tag variant="primary|secondary|success|warning|error|neutral" size="sm|md|lg" removable onRemove={…} icon={…}>`: A label for a category, filter or selection.
- `<EmptyState icon={…} title={…} description={…} action={…} size="sm|md|lg">`: A placeholder for when there's nothing to show yet: icon, title, description and an action.
- `<Stat label={…} value={…} change={…} trend="up|down|neutral" icon={…}>`: A key metric: label, value and an optional change colored by `trend`.

### Navigation

- `<Tabs value={…} defaultValue={…} onValueChange={…}>`: Tabbed panels: one `TabsContent` shows at a time.

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="profile">
  <TabsList aria-label="Settings">
    <TabsTrigger value="profile">Profile</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="billing">Billing</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="profile">…</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="billing">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

- `<Accordion multiple value={…} defaultValue={…} onValueChange={…}>`: Expandable sections.

```tsx
<Accordion defaultValue="shipping">
  <AccordionItem value="shipping">
    <AccordionTrigger value="shipping">Shipping</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent value="shipping">Ships in 2 days.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="returns">
    <AccordionTrigger value="returns">Returns</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent value="returns">30-day returns.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

- `<Breadcrumbs separator={…}>`: A breadcrumb trail: a `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` with an ordered list of `BreadcrumbItem`s and a decorative separator between them.

```tsx
<Breadcrumbs>
  <BreadcrumbItem href="/">Home</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbItem href="/projects">Projects</BreadcrumbItem>
  <BreadcrumbItem active>Harmonium</BreadcrumbItem>
</Breadcrumbs>
```

- `<Pagination page={…} totalPages={…} onPageChange={…} maxVisible={…}>`: Previous/next buttons and page numbers.
- `<TopBar fixed>`: An application header bar (`<header>`) with `TopBarSection`s aligned left, center or right.

```tsx
<TopBar>
  <TopBarSection align="left"><strong>Acme</strong></TopBarSection>
  <TopBarSection align="right"><Avatar fallback="JD" size="sm" /></TopBarSection>
</TopBar>
```

### Data

- `<Table striped hoverable responsive>`: A semantic HTML table built from `TableHead`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHeader` (`<th>`) and `TableCell` (`<td>`).

```tsx
<Table striped hoverable responsive aria-label="Invoices">
  <TableHead>
    <TableRow><TableHeader>Invoice</TableHeader><TableHeader>Amount</TableHeader></TableRow>
  </TableHead>
  <TableBody>
    <TableRow><TableCell>#1024</TableCell><TableCell>$120</TableCell></TableRow>
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

- `<DataGrid columns={…} data={…} rowKey={…} sort={…} defaultSort={…} onSortChange={…} tableProps={…} striped hoverable>`: A table driven by `columns` and `data`.

### Overlays

- `<Dialog open onClose={…} size="sm|md|lg|full">`: A modal dialog, rendered in a portal on `document.body`.

```tsx
<Dialog open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} size="sm">
  <DialogHeader>Delete project?</DialogHeader>
  <DialogBody>This can't be undone.</DialogBody>
  <DialogFooter>
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
  </DialogFooter>
</Dialog>
```

- `<Drawer open onClose={…} side="left|right" size="sm|md|lg">`: A modal panel that slides in from the left or right edge.
- `<Tooltip content={…} side="top|bottom|left|right" delay={…}>`: A short description shown when its child is hovered or focused.
- `<Popover content={…} side="top|bottom|left|right" open onOpenChange={…}>`: Floating content that opens when its child is clicked.
- `<Menu trigger={…} side="top|bottom|left|right" open onOpenChange={…}>`: A list of actions.

```tsx
<Menu trigger={<Button variant="outline">Actions</Button>}>
  <MenuLabel>Project</MenuLabel>
  <MenuItem onClick={rename}>Rename</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem onClick={duplicate}>Duplicate</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem variant="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

- `<CommandPalette open onClose={…} items={…} placeholder={…}>`: A modal, searchable command list (the "Command-K" pattern).

### Feedback

- `<ToastProvider position="top-right|top-left|bottom-right|bottom-left">`: Shows the toasts created with `useToast()`; wrap your app in it once.

```tsx
<ToastProvider position="top-right">
  <App />
</ToastProvider>
```

- `useToast`: Shows toasts from anywhere inside a `ToastProvider`.

```tsx
const {toast} = useToast()
toast({message: 'Saved', variant: 'success'})
```

### Wizard

- `<Stepper activeStep={…} orientation="horizontal|vertical" completedLabel={…}>`: Progress through a multi-step flow.

```tsx
<Stepper activeStep={1}>
  <Step label="Account" />
  <Step label="Profile" description="Tell us about you" />
  <Step label="Confirm" />
</Stepper>
```

### Marketing

- `<PricingTable columns={…}>`: A responsive row of `PricingCard`s, one per plan.

```tsx
<PricingTable>
  <PricingCard>
    <PricingCardHeader>Free</PricingCardHeader>
    <PricingCardPrice amount="$0" period="/month" />
    <PricingCardFeatures>
      <PricingCardFeature>1 project</PricingCardFeature>
      <PricingCardFeature included={false}>Custom domains</PricingCardFeature>
    </PricingCardFeatures>
    <PricingCardFooter><Button variant="outline" expanded>Start free</Button></PricingCardFooter>
  </PricingCard>
  <PricingCard featured>
    <PricingCardHeader>Pro</PricingCardHeader>
    <PricingCardPrice amount="$29" period="/month" />
    <PricingCardFeatures>
      <PricingCardFeature>Unlimited projects</PricingCardFeature>
      <PricingCardFeature>Custom domains</PricingCardFeature>
    </PricingCardFeatures>
    <PricingCardFooter><Button expanded>Upgrade</Button></PricingCardFooter>
  </PricingCard>
</PricingTable>
```
